verdict.rationale: A managed analytical database could plausibly ship natural-language querying over a governed semantic layer, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only an MCP server that lets coding agents run raw SQL, plus column-level access roles. Neither is a semantic layer or a natural-language answering feature for business users, so these are adjacent building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, business users can ask questions in natural language and get governed, semantically-grounded answers rather than hallucinated joins
